description: Keelcrew's rules for crew sessions (from rules/rules.json and the team pack), the ship approval record, and crew activity for the board. They act only in sessions that joined with `keelctl register` and in registered engineer and agent folders, except that no session may call the helper's board-only tools, and that a damaged crew file makes every session ask before anything that could ship. In crew sessions a call that needs a person is denied with the next step (promptMode deny, the default) or asks (promptMode ask); if the policy itself fails, crew calls are refused or asked, never waved through. `modules` names the panel (register.tsx), which runs inside each session: it wakes the Mate when the captain acts on the board, draws each engineer's band and answers /keel-panel. The Notification hook shows the panel's notifications titled Keelcrew (urgent, ship and failed QA cards whose Claude app push wasn't sent) as macOS banners, since a session in the Claude app has no terminal to show them. The ledger hook records the commits each crew engineer's command made on its ticket's record.
